newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 6,183 to dollar for Feb 10 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 6,183 to dollar for Feb 10 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 6,183 to the dollar for February 10.
The reference rate set on Thursday is a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Wednesday for February 7 to 9 is 6,069 to the dollar. It was 5,978 on Thursday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
